FOR ALL
More

FOR ALL - ADULTS IN FOCUS, CHILDREN WELCOME

Everyone is welcome here in the world of ROBINSON. The interests of adults are in the foreground, yet children and especially teenagers will also find fantastic and age-appropriate holiday programmes and offers in these resorts. Loving childcare is provided by our ROBINS from the age of 3. The ROBY CLUB is open 6 days a week, with hourly care and programme times. Of course, the clubs can also be booked by families with babies and toddlers from the age of 0. Sport and fun characterise the varied entertainment and WellFit programmes. In addition to 3-4 shows per week, guests can look forward to special live acts once a week. Exciting and relaxing holiday experiences for big and small guests.

International flair
More

International flair

This club is very popular with guests of different cultures from all over the world, which is why many programs and courses are also held in English.

Location
More

Location

The resort is situated on the stunning eastern coast of Algarve, in the heart of the unspoiled Ria Formosa nature preserve, and between two exclusive golf courses. A long sand island stretches along the coast. The changing tides transform the coastal scenery every day as nature offers a fascinating show.

Overview of location:

  • On the eastern coast of Algarve

  • In the heart of the unspoiled Ria Formosa nature preserve

  • On the lagoon sand beach

  • Beach: public, long sand island, fine, sandy
     

Distances:

  • Faro airport: 45 km, transfer time from Faro: approx. 50 minutes

  • Beach: 1 km, reachable on foot in about 10 minutes, free shuttle from the resort to the sunbathing area

  • Tavira center: approx. 10 km, travel time by taxi approx. 15 minutes

  • Nearest supermarket in Tavira (10 km)

  • Nearest pharmacy in Cabanas (4 km)

  • Nearest hospital in Faro

  • Nearest bus stop reachable by foot in about 10 minutes (to Tavira & Faro and to Vila Real de Sant Antonio almost hourly)
     

TRANSFER FROM THE CLUB TO FÁBRICA BEACH

You can reach the beautiful Praia da Fábrica directly by train and boat. Enjoy unforgettable days at the beach and leave everyday life behind!

  • Departure point: in front of reception
  • Distance: 1.7 km
  • Travel time by train: 10 minutes
  • Travel time by boat: 4 minutes
  • Period: 18 May – 30 October 2026
  • 5 days a week (7 days in July and August)
  • Times: from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. & 2:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.
  • Frequency: approx. every 30 minutes
  • Price: €3 per person aged 10 and over (children under 10 travel free) per day (max. €20 per stay)

FEATURES

  • Size of the club grounds: 99,800 m²
  • Number of rooms: 270
  • Residential blocks: 8
  • Floors: 2
  • Lift: not available

  • Conference area: a 250-square-metre conference room (can be divided into 4 smaller rooms) for up to 220 people
  • Pets not permitted

  • Credit cards: TUI Card/VISA, MasterCard, American Express, EC Card/MAESTRO
  • Languages spoken at the hotel: German, English and Portuguese
  • National rating: 4 stars

CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT At ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA, rooms are available from 3.00 pm on the day of arrival. On the day of departure, check-out is by 11.00. Subject to availability and in consultation with reception, a late check-out can be booked for a fee of €55 until 15.00 or €90 from 15.00 onwards.

TOURIST TAX A tourist tax has been levied in the district of Vila Real de Santo António since 19 November 2018. The tax is based on the type/category of accommodation and must be paid by the guest on site, directly at the hotel. For guests at the ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA, the tax is 1 euro per day per person aged 14 and over, and 0.50 euro per day for children aged 11–13; it is charged for a maximum of 7 days. Children up to and including the age of 10 are exempt.

NOTE FOR PEOPLE WITH REDUCED MOBILITY The club is generally suitable for people with reduced mobility. Please contact the robinson.com Service Centre to enquire whether it meets your individual needs.

MINORS TRAVELLING ALONE

  • The club does not accept bookings from minors travelling alone (under 18 years of age). 
  • The club will only accept bookings from minors (under 18 years of age) if they are accompanied by an adult and a written declaration of consent from their parents or legal guardians is provided.
AWARDS
More

ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA receives British Airways accolade

ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is delighted to announce that it has received a British Airways Holidays Customer Excellence Award for 2024. The resort has been recognised for the great lengths it has gone to in making every customer’s stay memorable and every holiday truly count.

Based on unbiased guest reviews, this accolade recognises outstanding services, facilities and customer experiences offered by hotels around the world. ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA a received an overall score of 4.7/5.

RoomHopper – new!

Your holiday dates are no longer available? No problem – become a ROBINSON RoomHopper!

For flexible guests (RoomHoppers) we have rooms in a period that's usually booked out. This allows you to spend your favourite time of year at your favourite resort. You also get the opportunity to check out more room categories and even get a room upgrade while still paying the price of the cheapest category. Depending on availability and duration of stay, you may have to change your resort room up to four times. You will be informed of the exact room category and number of changes at check-in.

Room changes mean leaving your room by 11 a.m. Your new room will be available no later than 3 p.m. on the same day.

The ROBINSON luggage service will take care of your bags. RoomHoppers simply leave their packed bags or suitcases in their current room to be taken to the new room. You are welcome to leave any valuables at reception.

Activities

Discover more information, highlights and tips for your stay in the ROBINSON app.

WellFit

In our WellFit area you can experience our unique blend of wellness and fitness. Do you just want to unwind? Then relax in the WellFit Spa and let yourself be pampered with massages and treatments.

Display more

The paths to mental and physical wellbeing are as diverse and individual as you. With our range of wellness and fitness offers, you’re sure to enjoy a holistic holiday experience.

FACILITIES
Fitness 

  • Fitness studio (from 16 years) incl. cardio and strength equipment as well as Power Plate station: Terminal (display/touchscreen) with virtual training programmes, including Functional training, fascia training, training for golfers etc.
  • GroupFitness room
  • Open-air WellFit area (weather permitting)
     

WellFit Spa (from 16 years) 

  • 1 Finnish sauna
  • 1 bio sauna 
  • Steam bath
  • Relaxation area
  • Massage and beauty rooms
     

GROUPFITNESS
Experience group dynamics, train your cardiovascular system, strengthen your muscles and enjoy a new physical awareness that will give you the energy to live life to the fullest. 
 

  • Strengthening (e.g. body styling), from 14 years
  • Endurance/Choreo (e.g. dance), from 14 years
  • Aqua Fit, from 14 years 
  • HOT IRON, from 16 years
  • Functional workout, from 14 years
  • XCO Shape/XCO Walking, from 14 years
  • Slings Athletic/TRX, from 14 years
  • Indoor cycling, from 16 years
  • PULSE, from 14 years 
     

BODY&MIND
Discover your core strength and unwind – do what’s good for you and feel your own strength and flexibility. Take time for yourself and allow your mind to roam free. 
 

  • Pilates, from 14 years
  • Yoga, from 14 years
  • Slings in rhythm, from 14 years
  • Stretch&Relax, from 14 years
     

PERSONAL TRAINING
Train with our ROBINSON personal trainers in one of the most beautiful places in the world! Receive competent and individual advice from one of our qualified personal trainers. Their know-how offers you a range of training options, including endurance training, figure optimisation, flexibility training, muscle building, sports-specific training, yoga or Pilates and, of course, lots of fun. 
 

  • Customised fitness programmes individually designed for you by our personal trainers (for a fee; bookable on site).
     

WellFit SPA TREATMENTS
Enjoy peace and quiet and let yourself be spoiled. Whether it’s a massage or beauty treatment, a steam bath or sauna – you deserve this wellness break.

Additionally charged treatments: 

  • Standard cosmetics treatment
  • Natural cosmetics treatment
  • Standard massage
  • Wellness massage
  • Ayurveda
  • Physiotherapy 
     

WellFit DAY
1x per week there is a WellFit day at the resort. WellFit day sees our ROBINS get creative and offer guests special classes.

BalAyur
Our new concept BalAyur (Bal = Balance, Ayur = Life) is based on the principles of Ayurveda and is a triad of WellFit-Active, WellFit-Spa and Food & Beverage.

In some cases for a fee (prices on request on site):
 

  • WellFit-Active: selected sports and personal training offers specifically designed to meet the needs of the body. These include walking courses, functional training, Pilates, meditation and yoga.
  • WellFit-Spa: Ayurvedic massages such as Abhyanga (Ayurvedic full body massage), Pristabhyanga (Ayurvedic back massage) or Padabhyanga (Ayurvedic foot massage) - can be booked individually or as a package.
  • Food & Beverage: Daily changing dishes based on the principles of Ayurveda in the main restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner as well as an additional bar menu with Ayurvedic drinks.

The services marked with an * can be booked locally with an external company. These are not services provided by ROBINSON or your tour operator.

Golf*

Are you a passionate golfer? Then ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is your paradise. There are two fantastic 18-hole courses right on your doorstep: QUINTA DA RIA and QUINTA DE CIMA. Enjoy unique views of the deep-blue Atlantic whilst you play. The challenging Quinta de Cima course has already hosted international golf tournaments.

Display more

Our ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is situated in the sunny Algarve in Portugal, with two fantastic golf courses right on its doorstep. As well as these top-class golf courses, there are plenty of other great courses waiting for you, including excellent courses such as the Jack Nicklaus-designed Monte Rei course.

Unspoilt beaches, direct access to the Atlantic, the superb condition of both golf courses and a vibrant competitive culture fostered by the ‘Clube de Golfe do Levante’, based at the resort, have long made this a well-kept secret among golfers in the ‘Sotavento’, in the eastern part of the Algarve. QUINTA DA RIA and QUINTA DE CIMA have received numerous awards from specialist magazines and golf guides! Do you have any questions about golf? Our Golf Robins are happy to assist you. Send us an email or give us a call. You can get answers to all your golf-related questions here: ROBINSON GOLF DESK QUINTA DA RIA

  • Tel.: 00351 281 959 085
  • Email: golf.quintadaria@robinson.com

OVERVIEW

Padel

Discover the exciting sport of padel here at ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA. Play on our modern padel courts and let our qualified coaches help you improve your game.

Display more

Although padel, also known as padel tennis, is still a very young sport, it is one of the fastest-growing sports worldwide. Developed in Mexico in 1965, the modern game was introduced to Europe in 1974 in Marbella, in southern Spain.

Facilities:

  • 2 padel courts (artificial grass with quartz sand)

For a fee:

  • Booking of padel courts, including equipment hire (rackets and balls), is available via the ROBINSON app from 24 hours in advance. For bookings made more than 24 hours in advance, a separate enquiry is required.
  • Balls for sale
  • Introductory padel sessions (group sessions) led by a coach
  • Courses
  • Guest tournaments (subject to availability)

Padel is played exclusively as a doubles game, usually over three sets, and generally follows the rules of tennis. Points are also scored in the same way as in tennis.

RULES OF THE GAME:

Serve

  • First serve from the right-hand side; the player stands behind the baseline
  • Underhand serve – the ball must bounce on the ground and be played no higher than hip height
  • The ball must be played into the diagonally opposite two-part T-area
  • The ball may hit the glass at most, but not the fence

Rally

  • The back and side walls may be used as part of the playing area
  • The ball must bounce once on the playing area before it touches the wall
  • The ball may bounce no more than once
  • The ball may only be returned once it has passed over the net
  • Volley shots are permitted
  • Players may hit the ball against their own walls to get it over the net

Sustainability - We are ROBsponsible!


At ROBINSON, we act responsibly and endeavour to use resources sustainably and efficiently. We combine sustainable practices with many small special projects. Here you can find the measures already implemented at this ROBINSON resort. You can read more about what sustainability means for ROBINSON here .
Energy

Our energy measures at the resort.

Display more
  • The club generates its own renewable energy (e.g. through the use of solar thermal, wind, photovoltaic or biomass).
  • Guest rooms have energy-saving switches (e.g. controlled electricity with room card).
  • The club has motion detectors in the rooms and public areas.
Food

Our conscious approach to food.

Display more
  • Vegan meals are offered.
  • Vegetarian meals are available.
  • The club has its own herb garden or greenhouse that contributes ingredients to the meals served in the restaurant(s).
Resources

Our careful use of resources.

Display more
  • The club has set itself targets to reduce food waste.
  • The club uses environmentally certified, biodegradable and ecologically safe cleaning products.
  • The club has installed water refill points and encourages guests to use these instead of single-use plastic water bottles.
Destination & Community

Information and thoughtfulness.

Display more
  • The club supports local charities or community events (e.g. through financial donations, sponsorship or donations in kind)
  • The club regularly trains its staff on how to save energy, water and resources and reduce waste in their day-to-day work.
Biodiversity & ecosystem

Supporting nature and creating oases of well-being.

Display more
  • The club offers bike hire.
  • The club offers e-bike hire.
  • There are green areas such as gardens/roof gardens on the property..
Water

Raising awareness and acting sustainably.

Display more
  • The club operates its gardens in an efficient manner to reduce water consumption (e.g. native or drought-resistant plants, watering gardens at night, etc.).
  • The club laundry ensures efficient consumption to avoid wasting water.
  • The club operates and cleans its swimming pools in a way that reduces water waste.
  • The club uses only water-efficient flush toilets.
  • The club uses properly treated wastewater within the hotel operations (e.g. for watering plants and gardens).

FAQ

  • Where is ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA located, and what defines its setting in Portugal?

    ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is located in the eastern Algarve, close to Tavira and directly within the Ria Formosa Natural Park. The club is surrounded by protected lagoons, salt marshes and golf courses rather than a classic resort strip. Its setting feels calm, open and strongly shaped by nature.

  • How close is ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA to the beach, and how do guests access it?

    ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is not directly on the open ocean but is set near barrier islands that form the Algarve coastline. Beaches are reached by short transfers across the Ria Formosa lagoon system. This layout creates a quieter atmosphere compared to beachfront resorts.

  • Who is ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA particularly suited for?

    ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is especially well suited to couples, active travellers and guests who value tranquillity over a lively resort scene. Golfers, nature lovers and those seeking space and calm tend to feel well matched to the club. The atmosphere is adult-oriented but not exclusive.

  • What makes ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA attractive for golfers?

    ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA is closely associated with its location between two established golf courses. The flat landscape and proximity of the fairways allow golf to be integrated into the daily rhythm of a stay. Golf is a defining characteristic of the club rather than an optional extra.

  • What should guests know about the climate and best travel periods for ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA?

    The eastern Algarve enjoys mild winters and warm, dry summers. Spring and autumn are particularly popular due to comfortable temperatures and lower humidity, while summer is typically hotter but moderated by Atlantic breezes. Weather conditions are generally stable throughout most of the year.

  • How secluded and spacious does ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA feel on site?

    ROBINSON QUINTA DA RIA feels spacious due to its low-rise architecture and open natural surroundings. The absence of dense neighbouring resorts enhances the sense of calm and privacy. Orientation details and nearby points of interest can be checked once in the ROBINSON App if further planning is needed.
